title: Basketball Weekly for Bi-Stone Region - NewsBreak
text:
By Stephen R. Farris ,
7 hours ago It was an exciting week of high school basketball for the Bi-Stone region. Not everyday you get to host a team from Australia either. That’s exactly what the Coolidge Yellowjackets did last Tuesday, as they hosted the traveling team from Warringah, Australia. The team was gracious enough to make visits to the elementary, junior high, and high school while they were here to answer student’s questions, then it was to the court for basketball action later Tuesday evening.
Most all area teams played in tournaments over the weekend.
Both Fairfield basketball teams swept through tournament play to capture the championship crown of their tournament. The Lady Eagles are currently 14-1, and are the No. 2 ranked team in Class 3A.
The Groesbeck basketball programs are off to a good start so far this season. The Goats are currently 7-4 this season, and the Lady Goats improved to 9-7, and are 1-0 in district play.
The Class 3A, No. 15 ranked Mexia Blackcats finished third at the Robinson Tournament over the weekend. The Blackcats Kelan Collins made the All-Tournament Team, averaging 28 points per game, four boards, and five assists. He had a 42point game against Lake Belton in the tournament. This marks the second tournament Collins has been selected to an alltournament team.
The Mexia Ladycats (011) played in the Fairfield Tournament. The Ladycats are still looking for their first win of the season. Hopefully it’ll come soon for these hardworking young ladies.
Over in Teague, the Lions are currently 6-3 on the year, and the Lady Lions are sitting at 5-10 and 0-1 in district play entering this week.
The Wortham Bulldogs (12-4) beat Rice to finish third at the Frost Tournament Saturday. Kaedon Busby was named to the All-Tournament Team.
Here’s a look at the results from last week, and a look ahead at upcoming games.
